A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the lower right corner of the game-text box frame, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 25 January 2018. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-commandervandenwillard-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Commander Vanden Willard (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same game text. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title, and the text box set again. There is no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits at the lower right corner of the game-text box frame.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 disc card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
